_comment: Tier-2 for dune::poisson (ds(id) works; ids are geometric and 1-based). dune/fem/misc/boundaryidprovider.hh returns intersection.indexInInside()+1 for YaspGrid, so on a 2D structuredGrid the boundary ids are 1=x-min, 2=x-max, 3=y-min, 4=y-max — geometric, not user-assigned. The fixture measures the partition directly (sum of 1*v*ds(k) is 1.0 for k=1..4, 0.0 for k=5, 4.0 for plain ds) and then solves -Laplace(u)=0 with u=0 on x=0 twice: unit flux on ds(1) — the CLAMPED edge — contributes nothing and gives an identically zero solution, while the same flux on ds(2) reproduces the exact u=x. That asymmetry is the trap: an earlier revision of this catalog concluded from the first case alone that dune-fem has no facet tagging. ds(0) is rejected with AssertionError at dune/ufl/linear.py:208. Verified by execution against dune-fem 2.12.0.2 on 2026-08-03; the per-id lengths were also measured as 1.0 each on aluConformGrid, but ALUGrid uses a different BoundaryIdProvider so the numbering is not assumed there. MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 puts the flux of the "clamped edge" run on ds(2), the FREE edge, instead of ds(1), the edge the Dirichlet condition clamps. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectations 'flux_on_clamped_edge_max_abs=0.000000', 'dune_boundary_ids_are_geometric_and_one_based=True' are no longer printed and the forbidden token 'FAIL:' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness). ENVIRONMENT: there is no ofa-dune conda env on this host, which is the interpreter scripts/run_tier2_fixtures.py falls back to; dune-fem 2.12.0.2 lives in ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env. Without DUNE_PYTHON set to that interpreter the runner records this fixture as `skipped`, not `failed`, so a summary that counts only passes and failures shows nothing wrong while nothing was executed. Every measurement quoted above, and the mutation verdict, was taken with DUNE_PYTHON=~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python.
